step_by_step_approach: Define the 12‑week period ending on June 15 2020.
Define the 12‑week period starting on June 15 2020.
For each attribute type (region, platform, age band, demographic, customer type), gather total sales for each attribute value during the before period.
For each attribute type, gather total sales for each attribute value during the after period.
Calculate the percentage change in sales for each attribute value from the before period to the after period.
Compute the average of those percentage changes for each attribute type.
Identify the attribute type with the most negative average percentage change.
Return that attribute type together with its average percentage change.
